title.narrative: Digitizing and Enhancing Accessibility of the National Atlas of Mongolia (E-NAM)

description.narrative: The project aims to create an electronic version of the National Atlas of Mongolia or E-NAM, which consists of thematic geographical images, incorporating research findings from disciplines such as history, archaeology, paleontology, biology, geology, physics, geophysics, ecology, geography, and cartography, by recreating the thematic geographical images in English and placing them on an online platform in two languages, Mongolia and English. This comprehensive and open-access atlas will provide and enhance the science-based knowledge and understanding of Mongolia to the general public and interdisciplinary researchers of all ages, genders, and ethnicities, which aligns with strategic orientations of UNESCO for period 2024-2025.
